text:
anya: heads up — onboarding rnk3b-mini (3B) quant build to staging. quick smoke: int8+kvpack. seeing ndcg -6% on core holdout vs fp16 baseline. pasting eval output below.

sam: can you paste the eval command you ran?

anya: sure, here's the exact invocation:
```
./rune_eval --model rnk3b-mini:int8 --holdout core_holdout.jsonl --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --batch 64 --seed 42
```

anya: output:
```
Baseline fp16: ndcg@10=0.312, mrr=0.421
rnk3b-mini:int8: ndcg@10=0.293 (-6.1%), mrr=0.418 (-0.7%)
```

mike: hmm that's odd — MRR is almost fine but NDCG drops more. could be dataset slice / truncation / tokenization.

rachel: tokenization shifts are a common culprit. did the int8 pipeline pick up the newer tokenizer build?

anya: i checked — staging had tokenizer v2 for int8 builds, while fp16 baseline used tokenizer v1. we accidentally flipped the default in the staging container.

sam: ok try forcing tokenizer v1 to check parity.

anya: re-running with `--tokenizer v1` now, ETA ~7m.

ci-bot: deploy-staging rnk3b-mini:int8 started by anya — build 1234

anya: run finished. new numbers:
```
rnk3b-mini:int8 (tokenizer v1): ndcg@10=0.305 (-2.2%), mrr=0.420 (-0.2%)
```

sam: nice — tokenizer diff explains most of the gap. still a small ndcg delta though.

mike: can we run cross-dataset checks? specifically longtail_holdout and core_holdout to see slice behaviour.

anya: queued longtail and core+random slices. also noticed a separate issue: some docs had raw HTML tags in the int8 preproc path (we have two preproc codepaths in the bringup script). might be an extra signal change.

rachel: yeah html noise can screw ranking. we should gate for exact text-normalization parity between pipelines.

mike: proposal — add two checks to the bringup checklist: 1) token id parity sample (compare token ids for 100 sampled queries) 2) stripped_text hash parity (html-strip + normalize) for sample docs.

anya: created PR #2896 that adds a small smoke test comparing token id sequences and stripped_text hashes between fp16 and int8 preproc. assigning to rachel and sam for review.

sam: please include the eval command and the seed in artifacts so we can reproduce exact runs.

anya: done — uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/onboard/rnk3b-mini/1714008888/ (includes meta.json, eval.log, sample-token-comparisons.jsonl)

mike: next isolation step: rerun quant calibration with kvpack disabled to see if kvpack packing interacts with quant noise.

anya: scheduled kvpack-off run. will update with numbers.

rachel: also, add a quick note in the onboarding doc about tokenizer version pinning. we've tripped on this before.

anya: added note in docs/bringup.md and linked PR in the thread.

sam: thanks. once kvpack-off run completes, let's decide if this needs a temporary rollback or if we can patch preprocessing for parity.

anya: kvpack-off run finished — results:
```
rnk3b-mini:int8 (tokenizer v1, kvpack off): ndcg@10=0.307 (-1.6%), mrr=0.420 (-0.2%)
```

mike: looks like kvpack added a small delta, but the tokenization mismatch was the dominant factor. good catch.

rachel: i'm merging the PR after a quick nits pass. we'll add the smoke to the CI bringup gate.

anya: merging now. thumbs up from sam and rachel.

sam: one last ask — can we include a tiny script that computes per-query ndcg delta and spits out top 50 regressors so SRE/product can sanity-check examples?

anya: adding that to the artifact upload (per_query_deltas.csv).

mike: perfect. outcome: no rollback needed, but we add stronger parity tests and update docs. closing loop.

anya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
